items.text: Dual-career couples plan best when they treat both careers as real, agree on shared goals and rules for moves, care duties and money, and review the plan regularly instead of letting one partner's career quietly absorb the adjustments.
Talk openly about goals, agree how to decide on relocations and care duties, and review every stage so neither career is sidelined by default.
Check the current policies before making plans that depend on them.
